## What's changed

- Kept Tube TV channels on the stable, portable Spline scaler instead of applying AI upscaling.
- Preserved each channel's fixed output profile, including 4K output, while maintaining the correct aspect ratio across programs, commercials, and bumpers.
- Restricted FSRCNNX and ArtCNN processing to on-demand movies and episodes, regardless of the global upscaling selection.
- Added regression coverage to ensure Tube TV commands never load an AI shader or model.

This is a server-side update; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
